sections.content:
You can think of this stage as encountering your Self for the first time.


You may not even be aware you were meeting your Self.


This stage is first experienced from your early years as your sense of self develops and you interact with others.


The first iteration of this stage tends to be an unconscious experience...


**Experiencing:** Encountering your Self through experience

<u>_**Initial phase**_</u>


The first time encountering your self is often when your life is on autopilot, with your conditioning plus current environment drawing you into experiences.


You could think of this as proverbially biting off experience to chew on and digest in years to come.


With a developing sense of self some of the common qualities:

- A perspective that life is happening to us.
- May experience victimhood and see circumstances as bad.
- Following the crowd & seeking external validation.
- Running off subconscious programming from our environment (upbringing + peers).
- A time of karma playing out - being drawn into experiences that need to occur.
- Greater likelihood of attracting negativity and low vibrational experiences.
- Life experience that will serve your highest growth, yet often don’t make sense until much later.
- Can be living in the moment but not in a healthy way

One may think of this like being in the gym working the muscle to create the stimulus for growth - the experiences here can be traumatic but ultimately give us something to heal from (and grow stronger).


It also defines our unique journey which can position us to be in the best place to help others.


I like a perspective of certain souls volunteering themselves for incredibly difficult journeys which are both for their highest growth and to better serve those that walk a similar path.


<u>**Subsequent Encounters**</u>


Subsequent encounters can involve us experiencing a particular version of ourselves (work role, 


This stage may be revisited any time our sense of self changes, with a new version of our self being experienced.


This can be a strengthened sense of self such as having gone through a period of Self Growth. This is often an uplifting experience almost like trying on a new set of clothes and liking how they look 😆


Or it can be the result of a diminished sense of self after having experienced trauma or a health setback. This is often a more challenging experience in which the following stages are equally more important and more difficult.
